svg.title: Confidence-gated KF+GRU hybrid architecture with dual-timescale adaptive R
svg.desc: Novel architecture showing three new mechanisms: (1) KF innovation norm computing a trust gate alpha that weights GRU correction, (2) post-correction residual feeding back into adaptive R rather than raw innovation, and (3) physics-locked hidden state projection using KF covariance P.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the innovation trust gate in detail')
sendPrompt('How does the trust gate modulate GRU correction?')
sendPrompt('Explain the post-correction residual feedback loop')
sendPrompt('How does dual-timescale adaptive R work?')
sendPrompt('Explain the physics-locked hidden state projection')
g.text: suppress h where P is small

svg.text: Claim 1: confidence-gated injection — alpha gates GRU based on KF innovation norm and P diagonal
Claim 2: post-correction residual feedback — adaptive R uses r = z - Cx̂_fused, not raw innovation ỹ
Claim 3: P-projection layer — KF covariance suppresses GRU hidden dims where physics is confident
Together: a self-regulating estimator where the physics model actively governs neural trust
